rule: An older subscription_updated (active) must not overwrite the later subscription_expired
invariant: SELECT status <> 'active' FROM subscription WHERE lemon_squeezy_id='s1'
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: INSERT INTO subscription(lemon_squeezy_id,status,event_updated_at) VALUES ('s1','active','2026-02-01 10:00:00+00') ON CONFLICT (lemon_squeezy_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,event_updated_at=excluded.event_updated_at WHERE subscription.event_updated_at IS NULL OR subscription.event_updated_at <= excluded.event_updated_at

INSERT INTO subscription(lemon_squeezy_id,status,event_updated_at) VALUES ('s1','expired','2026-02-02 10:00:00+00') ON CONFLICT (lemon_squeezy_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,event_updated_at=excluded.event_updated_at WHERE subscription.event_updated_at IS NULL OR subscription.event_updated_at <= excluded.event_updated_at
